name: 5x12
source:
The date is 12/12/12 and everyone seems to be talking about one topic only - the end of the world. To tell you the truth I couldn't care less. My world has ended a few weeks ago when I got kicked out of university. I'm not mad or sad about it. After all, it was my own fault. However everything I've been doing, my daily routine, my friends, my (non)learning... all that is a distant past now. To make things worse, my current job hunting period fills me with nothing but uncertainty. I wasn't able to find a single interview today that I could go to, and so I have another empty, lazy, and boring day ahead of me.

At least that's what I have thought. At exactly 12:12 a stranger visited me, introduced himself as the creator of this world. He invaded my apartment and demands I help him set up a celebration of the world's end.
translation:
日期是2012年12月12日，每个人似乎都在谈论一个话题——世界末日。说实话我一点也不在乎。几周前，当我被大学开除时，我的世界就结束了。我对此并不生气或悲伤。说到底，都是我自己的错。然而我所做的一切，我的日常生活，我的朋友，我的（非）学习……所有这些现在都已成为遥远的过去。更糟糕的是，我目前的求职期让我充满了不确定性。今天我找不到一个可以参加的面试，所以我又度过了空虚、懒惰和无聊的一天。

至少我是这么认为的。中午12点12分，一位陌生人来拜访我，介绍自己是这个世界的创造者。他闯入我的公寓并要求我帮助他举办一场世界末日的庆祝活动。
